<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>false</active><api_name>x_snc_aegis.AEGISDecisionLogger</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AEGISDecisionLogger</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var AEGISDecisionLogger = Class.create();
AEGISDecisionLogger.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    /**
     * Writes an immutable audit entry to x_snc_aegis_ai_decision_log.
     * Protected against update/delete by BR-1 and BR-2.
     *
     * @param {string} agentName - e.g. 'Resume Intelligence', 'JD Architect', 'Workflow'
     * @param {string} actionType - STAGE_TRANSITION | JD_DRAFT | RESUME_SCORE |
     *                              SHORTLIST_RECOMMENDATION | INTERVIEW_SCHEDULE |
     *                              FEEDBACK_SYNTHESIS | HIRING_RECOMMENDATION | CLOSURE_COMMUNICATION
     * @param {string} appSysId - sys_id of x_snc_aegis_application (or null)
     * @param {string} reqSysId - sys_id of x_snc_aegis_job_requisition (or null)
     * @param {string} inputSummary - Summary of inputs evaluated
     * @param {string} outputSummary - Decision/recommendation produced
     * @param {number} confidence - Confidence level 0.0 to 1.0 (or null)
     * @param {string} guardrails - Guardrail policies enforced
     * @returns {string} sys_id of created log record, or null on failure
     */
    logAction: function(agentName, actionType, appSysId, reqSysId,
                        inputSummary, outputSummary, confidence, guardrails) {
        try {
            var gr = new GlideRecord('x_snc_aegis_ai_decision_log');
            gr.initialize();
            gr.setValue('agent_name', agentName);
            gr.setValue('action_type', actionType);

            if (appSysId) gr.setValue('related_application', appSysId);
            if (reqSysId) gr.setValue('related_requisition', reqSysId);

            gr.setValue('input_summary', inputSummary);
            gr.setValue('output_summary', outputSummary);

            if (confidence !== null && confidence !== undefined) {
                gr.setValue('confidence_level', confidence);
            }

            if (guardrails) gr.setValue('guardrails_applied', guardrails);

            gr.setValue('logged_at', new GlideDateTime());

            var sysId = gr.insert();
            if (!sysId) {
                gs.error('[AEGIS] FAILED to insert decision log: ' + gr.getLastErrorMessage());
                return null;
            }

            gs.info('[AEGIS] Logged: ' + agentName + ' | ' + actionType + ' | Log: ' + sysId);
            return sysId;
        } catch (ex) {
            gs.error('[AEGIS] EXCEPTION in logAction: ' + ex.toString());
            return null;
        }
    },

    type: 'AEGISDecisionLogger'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>DEEPTHI</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-20 11:02:58</sys_created_on><sys_id>cca56bbb6d5f03107f44d98064d8972d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AEGISDecisionLogger</sys_name><sys_package display_value="AEGIS" source="x_snc_aegis">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="AEGIS">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_cca56bbb6d5f03107f44d98064d8972d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-23 14:38:14</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
